NAVIMOW.NAME: Segway Navimow
NAVIMOW.DESCRIPTION: Segway Navimow robot mowers via the Navimow cloud (EU region)

CLIENT_ID.NAME: Client ID
CLIENT_ID.DESCRIPTION: OAuth client id issued by Segway for this installation

CLIENT_SECRET.NAME: Client secret
CLIENT_SECRET.DESCRIPTION: OAuth client secret issued by Segway

REDIRECT_URI.NAME: Redirect URI
REDIRECT_URI.DESCRIPTION: The redirect URI registered for the client (empty if Segway registered none)

AUTHORIZATION_CODE.NAME: Authorization code
AUTHORIZATION_CODE.DESCRIPTION: Open the login URL shown in Status, sign in with the Navimow account and paste the code parameter of the address you are sent to. Used once

REFRESH_TOKEN.NAME: Refresh token
REFRESH_TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Optional, instead of an authorization code

POLL.NAME: Poll interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: One request for all mowers per interval

SCAN.NAME: Search mowers
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the mowers of the account

STATUS.NAME: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: OK, the login URL when a login is needed, or the last error

STATE.NAME: State
STATE.DESCRIPTION: isDocked, isRunning, isPaused, isDocking, isLifted, Error, Offline, ...

MOWING.NAME: Mowing
MOWING.DESCRIPTION: Write true to start mowing, false to send the mower to the dock

PAUSED.NAME: Paused
PAUSED.DESCRIPTION: Write true to pause, false to resume

DOCK.NAME: Return to dock
DOCK.DESCRIPTION: Write true to send the mower to the dock

STOP.NAME: Stop
STOP.DESCRIPTION: Write true to stop mowing where the mower is

RETURNING.NAME: Returning
RETURNING.DESCRIPTION: On the way to the dock
